Threshold-free graph-cluster enhancement with sample-label inference

Source: R/leviNetworkStatistics.R
leviGraphTFCEInference.Rd

Fits a moderated `limma` t-statistic for every gene, integrates the signed statistics over all thresholds with threshold-free cluster enhancement (TFCE) using biological network components as clusters, and assigns FWER-controlled P-values by permuting sample labels. `PGlobal` uses the joint maximum across genes and both directions.

leviGraphTFCEInference(
  expression,
  groups,
  networkCoordinatesInput,
  networkInteractionsInput = NA,
  fileTypeInput = "dat",
  test = unique(groups)[2],
  control = unique(groups)[1],
  blocks = NULL,
  n_perm = 999L,
  permutation_method = c("auto", "monte_carlo", "exact"),
  max_exact = 50000L,
  E = 0.5,
  H = 2,
  n_steps = 100L,
  seed = NULL,
  BPPARAM = SerialParam()
)

Arguments

expression

Log-scale genes-by-samples expression matrix with gene identifiers as row names.

groups

Two-level sample-group vector, one value per column.

networkCoordinatesInput, networkInteractionsInput, fileTypeInput

LEVI network inputs: node coordinates, optional interactions and the file type accepted by [levi()].

test, control

Group labels defining the `test - control` contrast.

blocks

Optional exchangeability blocks (e.g. donor identifiers). Labels are permuted only within blocks and the block enters the linear model as a fixed effect.

n_perm

Number of Monte Carlo sample-label permutations.

permutation_method

`"auto"`, `"monte_carlo"` or `"exact"`. `"exact"` enumerates every distinct label assignment; `"monte_carlo"` draws `n_perm` random permutations; `"auto"` uses the exact scheme when the number of assignments is at most `max_exact` and Monte Carlo otherwise.

max_exact

Maximum number of label assignments enumerated by the exact permutation scheme.

E, H

TFCE extent and height exponents applied to the component size and to the threshold height at every integration step.

n_steps

Number of threshold steps used to integrate the TFCE score between zero and the maximum statistic.

seed

Optional RNG seed.

BPPARAM

A [BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam] object controlling how the permutations are evaluated. The default runs them serially.

Value

A list with signed gene statistics, TFCE scores, FWER-adjusted P-values and the permutation null maxima.

Examples

network <- data.frame(ID = c("A", "B", "C"), X = 1:3, Y = 1:3)
edges <- data.frame(V1 = c("A", "B"), V2 = c("B", "C"))
expression <- matrix(rnorm(18), 3, dimnames = list(c("A", "B", "C"), NULL))
if (requireNamespace("limma", quietly = TRUE)) {
  leviGraphTFCEInference(expression, rep(c("control", "case"), each = 3),
    network, edges, fileTypeInput = "stg", n_perm = 3)
}
